# Draft:The Wise Owl Literary Awards 2026

----
Recognising outstanding works in fiction, non-fiction and poetry, the Wise Owl Literary Awards 2026 were held at Foothills Clubhouse in New Chandigarh on February 12, bringing together writers, poets, thinkers and readers for a day-long celebration of literature.
